patterns.note: Scrapbook-style organic layout with elements scattered like physical stickers on a ruled notebook background.
Scroll-driven parallax where individual stickers drift vertically at different speeds, creating a layered 3D depth effect.
A romantic, high-contrast palette of pastel pinks, deep purples, and vibrant magentas that perfectly aligns with the romance novel genre.
Juxtaposition of bold, retro display serifs with casual, handwritten script fonts to mimic personal journaling.

technique_notes: Recreate the floating sticker parallax by absolute-positioning SVG or high-res PNG sticker graphics with a thick white stroke and a soft, offset drop shadow. Apply scroll-linked Y-axis translations with varying speed coefficients to simulate depth.
Implement the ruled notebook background using a repeating linear gradient CSS background pattern to keep the asset lightweight and scalable.
Use a continuous horizontal marquee at the bottom of the viewport with an infinite translate animation to display key accolades without cluttering the main canvas.

design_tokens.type_scale: High-contrast pairing of oversized, heavy display fonts for branding and expressive handwritten scripts for subheaders.

standout: The site brilliantly gamifies the author's portfolio by turning romance novel tropes into interactive, floating stickers that react dynamically to the user's scroll, transforming a simple bio page into a tactile, nostalgic scrapbook experience.
